apps.name: DuckTV IPTV & M3U Player
apps.description:
DuckTV is a player. It does not provide, sell, or host any TV channels, streams, or IPTV subscriptions, and it comes with no content of any kind. There is nothing to watch until you sign in with an account you already have from a provider you already pay. You bring the account; DuckTV brings the interface.

If you already have an Xtream Codes or M3U login from your provider, type the server address, your username and your password, and DuckTV turns that line into a proper TV app on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad.

WHAT DUCKTV IS NOT
• Not a channel provider. No channels, no playlists, no streams are bundled.
• Not a subscription service for television. There is no signup, no provider directory, and no way to buy TV inside the app.
• Not tied to any one company. Any standards-compliant Xtream Codes panel works.

WHAT YOU GET

Live TV that behaves like television
One playback engine, so changing channel is instant instead of a reload. Slide-in channel and category lists, a now/next info bar, favourites, recent channels, and a full time-grid guide with a live now-line when your provider sends EPG data. Prefer a better guide than your panel ships? Point DuckTV at your own XMLTV URL instead.

Movies and Series
Your provider's on-demand catalogue in a poster grid with categories, sorting and search. Playback remembers where you stopped, and picks the next episode up automatically.

Search
One field across live channels, movies and series.

Sports
Live scores, schedules and standings for NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and basketball, major soccer competitions and Formula 1 — pulled from public sports data, not from your provider. A spoiler shield hides scores until you ask for them. If you play Yahoo Fantasy, you can connect your Yahoo account (an integration Yahoo has approved) to see your team, your matchup and your players alongside the game.

Multiview
Watch several channels at once in a grid on Apple TV, with audio following the tile you pick.

DVR
Record live TV to the device and play it back from the DVR tab.

Parental controls
A PIN that hides categories you choose, and hides adult categories across Live TV, Movies and Series until the PIN is entered. Because the channels come from your provider and not from us, DuckTV cannot know or filter what is on them — these controls, and your provider's own account settings, are how you decide what is reachable on your device.

A player that actually plays things
DuckTV uses VLC (libVLC) as well as Apple's own engine, so MPEG-TS, HEVC and MKV streams that AVPlayer refuses simply play. Buffer size, hardware decoding and stream format are yours to tune, and an optional stats overlay shows bitrate, resolution and frame rate while you watch.

Built for the remote and for the phone
The Apple TV app is built around the focus engine and the Siri Remote. The iPhone and iPad app is a real touch app — not a stretched TV layout — with Picture in Picture for on-demand playback and background audio.

PRIVACY
Your server address, username and password are stored on your device in the keychain and sent only to your provider. They are never sent to us. There are no ads, no ad identifiers and no third-party tracking SDKs. Anonymous diagnostics can be switched off entirely in Settings → Privacy. Yahoo Fantasy and DuckTrack only do anything if you connect them yourself.

ONE MORE TIME, BECAUSE IT MATTERS
DuckTV has no relationship with any IPTV provider and does not recommend, endorse or resell one. What you watch, and whether you have the right to watch it, is between you and whoever you get your line from. Use DuckTV only with content you are authorised to access.

Requires an Apple TV, iPhone or iPad running tvOS/iOS 17 or later, an internet connection, and your own Xtream Codes or M3U account from a provider.

Questions, or something not working? help@duckingstats.com

apps.releaseNotes:
A big update: a new side rail that gives landscape screens their full height back, films that no longer stall at 17 seconds, subtitles and soundtracks that now play where they did not, and your favourites and Continue Watching kept safe when a playlist refreshes.

NEW
• Side rail in landscape. Turn your iPhone or iPad on its side and a playlist's tools fold into a slim rail of icons down the left - back, Search, Live, Radio, Films, Series, More and Settings - so channels and posters get the whole height of the screen. Tap an icon to use it, or press and hold the rail to see its labels. It works in every layout: Showcase, Grid and List.
• Prefer the old bar across the top? Settings › Display › Landscape navigation lets you choose between the side rail and the top bar. Held upright, the bar is always on top.
• Search from the rail opens a full search page, with your recent searches under the box.
• Screen edge margin. If a case or the rounded corners of your screen hide something, Settings › Display › Screen edge margin keeps up to 5% clear round the edges. It starts at 0%, using the whole screen.
• A new loading animation throughout the app.

PLAYBACK
• Films that stopped to buffer at about 17 seconds now play through. Some films are encrypted in a way the player on iPhone and iPad could not unlock; the app now prepares the key itself before playing. This also covers films whose soundtracks come as separate streams.
• Subtitles that were listed in the menu but never appeared now show. Some providers link their subtitle tracks to the film the wrong way, and the player could not connect the two. The app now repairs the list before playing, whatever names the provider uses.
• Films that played silently for the same reason now play with their sound.
• The audio language you pick is remembered for each channel.
• Subtitles on DASH streams keep better time with the picture.

SUBTITLES
• No more repeated entries in the subtitle list.
• English subtitles labelled "Bahasa English" are no longer shown as Malay.
• Fixed a case where no subtitle came on even though one was chosen.
• Language names are now the same in every menu, whichever player is used.

FIXED
• Favourites and Continue Watching could disappear after a playlist refreshed - when a provider changed its links, listed the same title twice, or briefly answered with an empty list. Your favourites, watch history and resume points now follow each title, an empty answer from a provider no longer wipes your list, and entries that went missing in earlier versions come back by themselves the next time the playlist loads.
• Parental locks, per-channel audio and subtitle choices and programme reminders now follow a channel when its link changes, too.
• On an iPhone held sideways some windows were taller than the screen, and their last option could not be tapped - most noticeably List in the Layout window, the VOD option in Arrange, and the sort options. Every one of these windows now scrolls.
• Windows with a text box no longer push their buttons out of reach while the keyboard is up.
• "See all", More categories and search inside a Showcase always show a grid.

ALSO
• Playlists from premium providers open on the Showcase pages the provider has chosen.
• Problem reports now include picture and sound timing details, so out-of-sync playback can be traced.

apps.name: Neverlag: IPTV Player Live TV
apps.description:
Neverlag is the IPTV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that doesn’t reload when your stream hiccups. Live TV, TV guide (EPG) and catch-up with your own provider – via Xtream Codes or an M3U playlist.
If your provider drops out for a moment, Neverlag keeps playing from its reserve. If a channel delivers no picture, Neverlag switches the source instead of freezing.

PLAYS ON WHILE OTHERS RELOAD
Neverlag builds a reserve of the programme you’re watching – up to 45 seconds by default, adjustable up to 90 seconds. When your provider stalls, playback continues from that reserve while Neverlag reconnects in the background and picks up where the picture left off. The quality panel shows reserve, delay behind live, bitrate and picture.

SWITCHES THE SOURCE INSTEAD OF FREEZING
If the picture freezes or a channel fails at the provider, Neverlag takes another source of the same channel or the same channel from another of your lists. One line tells you what happened, one button takes you back. If 4K keeps stalling, Neverlag drops to Full HD and tells you.

YOUR IPHONE AS THE REMOTE
With Neverlag on iPhone or iPad you control Neverlag on Apple TV: a D-pad like the Siri Remote or a touch area, your channels as tiles, pause/live and 30 seconds back. From iOS 18 also from Control Center, without opening the app. Several Apple TVs at home: pair, name, switch.

PROFILES FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Every profile has its own favorites and history. The admin profile protects settings with a PIN; the kids profile shows only approved groups.

TV GUIDE, ARCHIVE AND CATCH-UP
A TV guide grid from your provider’s EPG data (XMLTV). Missed shows in the archive, by show or by channel, when your provider offers catch-up. Neverlag tags programmes like football, news or kids automatically. Pause, rewind and record live TV – stored locally on Mac, iPhone and iPad, on your network storage on Apple TV.

BIG LISTS UNDER CONTROL
Groups, favorites, search and a jump bar that gets you to the right letter even with more than 10,000 channels. Movies and series with resume, when your provider includes them. 4K playback; on Mac, Neverlag matches the display’s refresh rate to the programme in full screen.

NEW DESIGN
A calm, dark interface on every device. Settings in clear sections, with search and an explanation for every option.

SET UP APPLE TV WITHOUT TYPING
No server addresses typed with the remote: Apple TV shows a code, your iPhone or Mac sends the login over your home network.

PRIVACY
No account, no tracking, no analytics, no ads. Neverlag has no server of its own: your login stays in your device’s keychain, measurements stay on the device.

TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION
Free download and a free 7-day trial. After that, keep watching with a subscription, monthly or yearly, cancel anytime. One subscription covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, with Family Sharing. Setup, channel list and TV guide stay free without a subscription.

Xtream-Masters IPTV Player is a fast, modern media player for iPhone and iPad. It plays the media sources that you add yourself: a single stream URL, an M3U playlist, or a login from a media provider that supports the standard player API.

NO CONTENT INCLUDED

THREE WAYS TO ADD YOUR MEDIA

- Provider login: if your media provider supports the standard player API, enter the server URL, username and password they gave you, and the app shows your library.

PLAYER FEATURES
- Hardware-accelerated playback
- HLS, DASH and HTTP/HTTPS streaming
- MP4, MKV, MP3 and other common formats
- EPG (program guide) for your own playlists
- External subtitles (.srt, .vtt)

- Brightness and volume gestures, double-tap to seek
- Picture-in-Picture
- Parental control PIN to lock categories
- Light, dark and automatic themes
- Available in 25+ languages

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No sign-up with us and no in-app purchases. Your sources, credentials and playlist URLs are stored only on your device and are never sent to the developer. Anonymous crash reports help us fix bugs.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
You are responsible for the media you add. Only use streams and playlists that you own or are legally allowed to access in your country. Please read the in-app Terms and Disclaimer, available from the login screen.

REQUIREMENTS
iOS 16.0 or later. Works on iPhone and iPad.

- Playback in an external player on iOS and macOS: Infuse and VLC.

- Animated rating stars.

- The favorite button is now filled.

- Kept downloads active on mobile networks and during long transfers.
- Resolved download redirects and properly sent the configured User-Agent.

- The Apple video player (iOS / macOS) no longer automatically selects subtitle tracks on start.

- The player selection dialog now focuses only one option.

- Reworked application startup flow with clearer error messages and a functioning retry button.
- Improved network connectivity detection with a fallback probe and smooth offline mode transition.
- Startup loading messages are now localized.
- Fixed subscription purchase date displaying the expiration date instead.
- Improved authentication error handling with clearer feedback.
- Sending a password recovery email now restores the authentication screen correctly.
- The login QR code no longer changes while it is displayed.
- Fixed the progress displayed while loading M3U playlists and reset it after an error.
